newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta Suncrest Hotel reports smaller loss.
newsitem.headline: Malta Suncrest Hotel reports smaller loss.

text.p: Suncrest Hotels plc, Malta's largest hotel and the only one listed on its stock exchange, has reported a loss of 231,000 Malta pounds for the six months up to the end of April 1997, down from a loss of 282,000 pounds for the same period in 1996.
The company said it had improved its performance in the six months both in terms of turnover and trading results, with occupancy and revenue up from the same period last year.

The results reflected the low season in tourism and "would typically be converted into a positive result once the following six months, which incorporate the peak summer months, are accumulated with the low season's."
The company said it expected occupancy and revenue to be higher this summer than in 1996.
